title: Challenger route map and class timeline
subject: History
unit: Summer 1: Ocean exploration in the 19th century (Blue Abyss)
source: Written for history/y4 lesson 19 (Challenger route map and class timeline (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 19: HMS Challenger: exploring the deep ocean, 1872 to 1876. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.text: Join the places in order with arrows to show the voyage round the world.

panels.title: What they did
points: Measured depth with a weighted rope
Dragged nets along the sea floor

panels.title: What they found
points: About 4,700 new kinds of sea life
Mud and rocks from the deep floor
A depth of about 8,200 m in the Mariana Trench

keywords.def: a long journey to explore or find out
a person who studies the world carefully

questions.q: Where did HMS Challenger start its voyage?
About how many new kinds of sea life did they find?
Core: Write a ship's log entry for 1875 as a Challenger scientist: where you are, what you measured, and what you found. Use the portal response box and start 'Today we...'
questions.a: A log using accurate facts: the Pacific, a weighted rope, a depth of about 8,200 m, new specimens

questions.q: Extend: Place the expedition on the class timeline after 1066 and the Domesday Book.
Stretch: Why was the expedition important for science?
questions.a: It was the first big study of the deep ocean and found thousands of new species

questions.q: Challenger Deep is named after a:
questions.a: B) Ship. It is named after HMS Challenger, the ship whose crew first measured it.

questions.q: Big question: why spend years measuring water and mud?
questions.a: To discover how deep the oceans are, what lives there and what the floor is made of
